author: cmungall
body: This uniprot entry (a wheat protein) has annotations from KW + IBA https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/A0A3B6GK97/entry ``` DR GO; GO:0004620; F:glycerophospholipase activity; IBA:GO_Central. DR GO; GO:0047372; F:monoacylglycerol lipase activity; IBA:GO_Central. DR GO; GO:0006952; P:defense response; IEA:UniProtKB-KW. DR GO; GO:0006629; P:lipid metabolic process; IEA:UniProtKB-KW. ``` The corresponding QuickGO page has ARBA and InterPro https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/annotations?geneProductId=A0A3B6GK97 |QUALIFIER|GO TERM|GO NAME|GO ASPECT|ECO ID|GO EVIDENCE CODE|REFERENCE|WITH/FROM|TAXON ID| |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| |involved_in|GO:0006629|lipid metabolic process|biological_process|ECO:0000256|IEA|GO_REF:0000002|InterPro:IPR002641|4565| |enables|GO:0016787|hydrolase activity|molecular_function|ECO:0000256|IEA|GO_REF:0000117|ARBA:ARBA00026276|4565| Same with the API: ```bash curl -L -H 'Accept: text/tsv' \ 'https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/downloadSearch?geneProductId=A0A3B6GK97' \ -o A0A3B6GK97-goa.tsv ``` As expected, the AmiGO page has only IBA, until we switch: https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/gene_product/UniProtKB:A0A3B6GK97

body: Alex did an extra GOA release yesterday, saying "This release was not planned, but needed to solve inconsistency in UniProt reference proteomes and issues during PAINT file processing." This seems to have corrected things at QuickGO, at least for your example: There was definitely a (temporary) issue with the IBA pipeline - the Dmel GAF used for the latest FlyBase release (FB2026_02) lost >5000 IBA annotations.

author: pgaudet

Yes, @hattrill says they are now fixed (but they will remain missing in the latest FB2026_02 FlyBase web release, unfortunately)

author: hattrill
body: Sad, but true - the checks I ran detected the churn in IBAs but it was alongside so many obsoletions and changes that it wasn't taken as a systematic error. I have some thoughts on additional checks I can add to the FB pipeline to catch these things but I think that may be this should be thought of as prompt to put in continuous (?) checks for IEAs and pipelines that have a bulk upload component. Discuss on IEA WG today.
